I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Two things back this up, and Marcus can see both:
- Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had raised the door 6 duplicate arrivals on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up as two rows after a kiosk check-in plus a manual dispatch entry.
- The Quarrendon account page names Thea as the main contact and Dana Okafor as the account owner since June 2025.

I also told him Dana was the one handling the issue. The account page also has contract terms, but contacts are operational facts, so none of that was needed or shared.
